mapper.sql: s.supplier_name, s.phone AS supplier_phone, g.goods_name, g.sku, g.specification, g.price AS goods_price, sg.supply_price, u.username, u.email, ug.quantity AS buy_quantity, ug.buy_price, ug.buy_date
